title: Titan animatic from boards
description: A timed animatic for a TITAN shot or sequence from its storyboard frames or plates: each board held for its shot length, with 2D camera moves on the board and shot labels, for timing review before anything is animated.

body.subject: TITAN {{sequence}}: {{shot_count}} shots from [image_references], in shot order.
body.action: Each shot holds for its own length from the shot list {{shot_list}}; within a shot, one 2D move on the board (push in, pan, or hold) as the shot list says; cuts are hard cuts unless the shot list names a dissolve.
body.camera: 2D scale and translate on each board only (a Ken Burns move), at most one move per shot.
body.style: Boards full frame, letterboxed to {{aspect}}; a burned-in label per shot (sequence, shot number, length in frames) in mono in a corner, small but at least min_text_px.
body.constraints: Write ONE scene folder: an HTML entry plus its JS, CSS, fonts and images, nothing fetched from elsewhere. Expose window.__scene = {duration_s, width, height}, an async window.__setup() that loads every font and decodes every image and reports each one, window.__frame(t) that sets EVERY animated property from t (seconds) alone, and window.__audit() that lists the visible text with its box, size and colour. No Date, performance.now, Math.random, requestAnimationFrame, CSS animations or CSS transitions: easing and any flicker are closed-form functions of t. All text inside the 5% title-safe area, at least {{min_text_px}} px tall at the output size, with contrast of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24 px and up). No text over a busy image without a plate behind it. Shot lengths are whole frames at the output fps and sum to the duration exactly; the board images are used as given, never redrawn.

min_text_px.description: the smallest text at the output size; the self-check fails under 22

palette.default: the brand's own tokens from the supplied stylesheet
palette.description: where the colours come from; never invented

shot_list.description: project-relative path of the shot list (shot, board file, length in frames, move)

aspect.description: the frame the boards are letterboxed to

negatives: no camera move the shot list does not name
no shot length off by a frame

image_references.description: the boards or plates, one per shot, in shot order

gates.description: requests other than file: and data: during the render (the scene must be self-contained)
sampled frame with no visible mark: share of pixels carrying a local luminance step
warning only: a nearly empty sampled frame (a weak poster frame)
visible text box outside the 5% title-safe margin
measured contrast of fully visible authored text against the pixels around it (3.0 at 24 px and up)
authored text overlapping a figure or card box
frames differing when the receipt is re-rendered by verify (same engine, sequential order)
